hero.caption: Front and western side of the surviving main building from Eleutherian College, located at 6927 State Road 250 at Lancaster in Lancaster Township, Jefferson County, Indiana, United States.  Built in 1856, the building was used as a public school and community center after the college's closure in the 1880s.  Now a museum, it has been declared a National Historic Landmark.
